meta.name: Lazarus
meta.description:
In 2052, a Nobel Prize-winning neuroscientist develops a drug called Hapna — a cure-all that has the unexpected side-effect of causing death three years later. In response to this threat, a special force of agents—nicknamed "Lazarus"— is assembled to take on the malevolent Skinner.

Not complete. On your server: S1 6/13 (missing E7-13)

videos.title: Goodbye Cruel World
videos.overview: The miracle drug, Hapna, now threatens to wipe out humanity. A chronic jail-breaker named Axel is asked to find the only man with a cure: Dr. Skinner.

videos.title: Life in the Fast Lane
videos.overview: Genius hacker Eleina finds a potential lead to Skinner. The Lazarus team splits into two groups to investigate it, but both end up getting shot at.

videos.title: Long Way from Home
videos.overview: Searching Skinner's house and interviewing his old colleague reveals a new lead. Axel and Leland go to Istanbul but have trouble with local thugs.

videos.title: Don't Stop the Dance
videos.overview: The team investigates a club owned by a stockbroker who got rich off Hapna. One of his associates is the hacker Dr. 909, who may be helping Skinner.

videos.title: Pretty Vacant
videos.overview: The team tries to lure Skinner out of hiding with a fake cure staged by the president of Delta Medicinal, but a hacker named Popcorn Wizard butts in.

videos.title: Heaven Is a Place on Earth
videos.overview: A secluded commune where Eleina once lived is identified as a potential hiding spot for Skinner. She and Leland infiltrate it to find out for sure.

meta.slogan: Getting out of prison was easy. Now he has to save the world.
